name: motion-studio
description: Code-rendered motion graphics: HTML canvas + Playwright + ffmpeg, with optional synthesized sound.

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i out/silent.mp4 -i out/audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11,aresample=48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/final.mp4 && echo "-> out/final.mp4"
scripts.final: npm run render && npm run sound && npm run mux
